title: Chapter 06: OOP and Encapsulation in C
source_ref: Extreme C, Chapter 6: OOP and Encapsulation (pp. 149-182)
learning_objectives: Understand the cognitive bridge between mental concepts and runtime object models in memory
Distinguish between prototype-based (existence precedes essence) and class-based object construction
Implement explicit attribute encapsulation using C structures and calculate byte layouts
Master implicit behavior encapsulation and understand how C++'s hidden 'this' pointer maps to C's first pointer argument
Enforce information-hiding using opaque pointer declarations (incomplete types) to isolate private internals and preserve backward compatibility
Diagnose and prevent resource leaks in encapsulated data structures via mandatory destruction protocols
